load_sketchy_frames: load sketchy dataset frames from a TFRecords file using sketchy.load_frames
prefetch_dataset: prefetch dataset elements to improve iteration performance with dataset.prefetch
inspect_tensor_shapes: iterate over dataset examples and print each tensor name, dtype, and shape
display_example_images: display a sketchy dataset image using matplotlib plt.imshow on example pixels
run_sketchy_cli: run the sketchy dataset example as a CLI tool with optional show_images flag
